summary: Design agent completed Low-Level Design for NFR-SEC-002 (Issue #31) — Content Security Policy enforcement for LegoBuilder. LLD covers: strict CSP directive specification (script-src 'self', no unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval, frame-ancestors 'none', object-src 'none'), Nginx add_header configuration, ESLint no-eval/no-new-func/no-implied-eval rules, CI audit step (curl + grep CSP header verification), Playwright E2E CSP violation detection, threat model, error handling, and 7 test case mappings (T-FE-SEC-002-01 through T-FE-SEC-002-07). Draft PR is open on branch feature/31-nfr-sec-002-design awaiting Gate 6a human design review. Area: frontend.

human_review_required: [HIGH] Gate 6a Design Review — Draft PR must be reviewed and approved by a human before implementation begins. The LLD defines the CSP policy directives, Nginx configuration, and ESLint rules that enforce NFR-SEC-002.
[MEDIUM] Confirm that 'unsafe-inline' in style-src is acceptable given Tailwind CSS runtime style injection. If not acceptable, evaluate nonce-based approach (requires SSR/dynamic server).
[MEDIUM] Verify that no third-party CDN scripts are loaded in index.html before finalizing script-src 'self' only.
[LOW] Confirm Nginx is the sole HTTP layer (no CDN/reverse proxy stripping headers) before production deployment.
